stories.headline: Iranian Drones Hit Kuwait Airport as US-Iran Strikes Escalate
stories.thesis: The Middle East conflict crossed an infrastructure-targeting threshold when Iranian drones struck Kuwait airport. Gulf energy transit risk is being repriced from tail-risk to base-case.

stories.headline: Anthropic Targets $1tn Valuation as AI Capex Race Intensifies
stories.thesis: Anthropic's planned US share sale at near-$1tn valuation signals compute concentration is accelerating. AI rally momentum decouples from geopolitical sell-off.

stories.headline: Yen at 160/Dollar as BOJ Intervention Window Narrows
stories.thesis: USD/JPY hovers near 160, reviving intervention risk. Hong Kong's $550B Exchange Fund considers S&P 500 allocation — capital flows shifting on rate divergence.

stories.headline: OECD Warns of 'Dark Scenario' if Gulf Energy Crisis Drags On
stories.thesis: OECD formally flagged a Gulf energy crisis scenario linking it to inflation repricing risk. Oil markets trade the Iran premium cautiously but structurally underpriced.
